subject.title: Plugin register() promises silently ignored — async registration not awaited

question: Should packaged runtime plugins remain subject to OpenClaw's synchronous register contract, or should upstream OpenClaw formally support awaited asynchronous registration?
rationale: The requested behavior changes an upstream plugin lifecycle contract, while a Nix-specific source/version mismatch could instead be the actual defect.

options.title: Preserve synchronous registration
options.body: Identify the affected plugin versions and move their asynchronous setup outside register while keeping the current gateway contract.

options.title: Adopt asynchronous registration
options.body: Coordinate an upstream loader/API change that awaits registration with bounded startup and explicit error handling.

recommendation.title: Preserve synchronous registration
recommendation.body: Identify the affected plugin versions and move their asynchronous setup outside register while keeping the current gateway contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the best available routing candidate for the runtime-plugin packaging side of the contract decision.
